comments: Free, no account required. Built by GelFuzion, a US web studio, with ADA Title II work for small cities and towns in mind. The tool states that automated testing is a screening, not a certification, and gives users a manual checklist (keyboard access, focus, captions, reading order and others) to complete the evaluation.
features: Free online WCAG 2.1 AA checker. Scans one page or up to 8 key pages of a site with axe-core (via Google Lighthouse), lists each failing element with its success criterion and a plain-English fix, checks whether linked PDFs are tagged, flags overlay widgets and missing accessibility statements, and prints a report.
title: ADA Compliance Checker (Website Blueprints)
